turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. Before we discuss your account, may I have your name and identification details?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Good morning, Rachel. This is Daniel Lim. My FIN number is G five four seven one two zero nine W. My date of birth is the eleventh of January nineteen sixty.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Daniel. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak privately? I can keep the conversation focused.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I'm in my office with the door closed. The fund I'd like to invest in is Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund. I want to buy, please.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Your objective is to seek income and diversify through emerging-market bonds, with the flexibility to stay invested during market volatility. I'll use that objective for our discussion. For the transaction currency, would you like to use Japanese yen?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Please use the currency you just mentioned for this transaction. I would appreciate concise explanations as we go.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, an issuer default can reduce the value of the fund's bond holdings. Rising interest rates can also push bond prices down and reduce the fund's value. Do you understand how issuer defaults and rising interest rates could reduce the value of this fund?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand. Defaults can reduce the value of the holdings, and rising interest rates can lower bond prices and the fund's value.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee is 0.5% of the investment amount. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest in this fund. Having considered those risks, are you willing to accept losses on this investment?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses. I understand the main risks you've explained.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund because its emerging-market bond exposure supports your income and diversification objectives. Its pooled holdings spread exposure across issuers, although credit and market risks remain.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Okay, noted. My business calendar has been quite full, so I have been setting aside quiet time for personal administration rather than trying to handle it between meetings.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That sounds like a busy schedule. For account correspondence, I can keep the administrative updates brief and separate from unrelated messages.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you. That would make them easier to review. I'd like to commit an investment amount of 5,000,000. The quantity I want is 250 units. Please place a limit order with a limit price of 20,000 Japanese yen per unit.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please allow me a moment to finish my notes. There is no need to stay on the line for general housekeeping afterwards.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That's helpful. I prefer to deal with personal paperwork myself, away from the logistics team's daily correspondence.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I have an investment amount of 7,500,000 in Japanese yen. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Actually, the investment amount should be 5,000,000, as I originally instructed. Please correct your note.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I apologise for the note-taking error. With the amount corrected, please confirm your final instruction: buy 250 units of Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund using a limit order at a limit price of 20,000 Japanese yen per unit, for an investment amount of 5,000,000 in Japanese yen.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction, including the corrected investment amount. Please place the order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for your time, Daniel. I'll leave the general account housekeeping for your usual correspondence. Have a good day.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you, Rachel. Goodbye.
